description:
List all database connections configured in Quorum that are enabled for MCP access.

Returns connection metadata (id, name, type, environment). Never touches passwords.

Each connection says how a write is handled ("writes"), as the person set it in Quorum:
- "with approval in Quorum": propose it with quorum_propose_write; it runs only after the
  person approves it in Quorum (on PROD they also type a confirmation).
- "allowed writes run directly": allowed changes run through quorum_execute_query.
- "refused (PROD)": writes on this PROD connection are refused; it can be read.
- "none": the connection is read-only.
PROD connections are readable.

Use the returned id in all other quorum_* tool calls.
name: quorum_list_connections
title: List Quorum Connections
